reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/F1TOIuqT1gL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61TTHXgJ5aL._SY256.jpg These fans are a tremendous value. Colors are true and amazing, the halo effect is exquisite, and the daisy-chain-ability saves money on a hub. I bought two sets, and I was able to chain the fans and lighting together and they run beautifully.
You end up with a bit of a web of cables this way, but I suggest getting some cable ties and/or a roll of velcro strapping, and it's more manageable than you think. You can always forgo the PST connections and instead opt for a quality hub (some cases include these).
For everything that is included in the price, the looks and functionality and longevity (have used TR fans in numerous builds and they all hold up), you cannot beat these fans.

reviews.title: Excellent, super quiet fans.
reviews.comment: Bought these to replace the fans that came in my PC case.  I've dealt with a noisy PC for a while now and finally got tired of it.  Figured the majority of the fan noise had to come from one of two places - the power supply, or the case fans.  Took a shot on these case fans as it was MUCH less expensive to get these, than to replace a power supply.  The fans made a HUGE difference in PC noise.  No, the PC is not dead silent.  There is still fan noise audible, but it is MUCH lower than it was before.  With all the fans going (3 case fans, 1 Power supply fan, 1 CPU cooler fan, 3 graphics card fans); overall noise was cut in half (or more) just by replacing the original case fans with these.  These also have a really good LED design, with an LED ring surrounding the LED illuminated fan blades.  It's a nice touch that gives it just a little bit "extra" over generic LED fans.  Plus, this is apparently the exact same fan that came on my Thermalright CPU cooler, so at least those four fans all match now.

reviews.title: Super Silent with Stunning Performance and Aesthetics!
reviews.comment:
I recently installed the Thermalright TL-S12-S X3 CPU Fan, and I couldn't be happier with its performance!
First off, the installation was a breeze. The fan fits perfectly in my case, and the ARGB lighting adds a stunning visual appeal. The colors are vibrant and customizable, which really enhances the overall look of my setup.
In terms of performance, this fan works like a charm. It provides excellent airflow while keeping noise levels to a minimum. My CPU temperatures have noticeably improved, and I can even run demanding tasks without worrying about overheating.
Overall, the Thermalright TL-S12-S X3 is a fantastic choice for anyone looking to upgrade their cooling system with both performance and aesthetics in mind. Highly recommend!
